1. Click 'Open Download Page' to open kernel.org

firmware.vendor_intel: Intel adapter. If it starts in bootloader mode, see the setup guide.

firmware.vendor_broadcom: Broadcom adapter: no Realtek files needed.

firmware.vendor_barrot: Barrot adapter: no firmware files needed.
firmware.vendor_marvell: Marvell adapter. The Wi-Fi driver loads the firmware, so keep Wi-Fi on.
firmware.vendor_actions: Actions adapter: no firmware files needed.
firmware.from_vendor_driver: The %s firmware comes from the vendor's Windows driver. Install that driver, or put the firmware files in the firmware folder.
firmware.intel_files: Put Intel's firmware files in the firmware folder.

firmware.download_explain: Downloads these files from kernel.org and saves them in the firmware folder.

fones.write_test.text: This version can change Game mode, Sleep mode, Wind reduction, Noise control (noise cancelling, scenes and transparency) and Wear detection; Prompt volume is shown read-only.
